answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is randomized grading-panel rotation: each epoch, work items are scored by a small panel of reputation-weighted agents drawn by a verifiable random function, so nobody knows which jury judges them. Colluders must corrupt unpredictable panels, and since reputation rides along with draws, they must sink a large share of staked identity-credit to sway one verdict. Attackers bluffing quality get their stake carved down like weathered marble, while a ridge of honest graders forms a harbor against collusion, making fakes costly.
